name: BDPIntendedRecipient
title: BiologicallyDerivedProduct Intended Recipient
description: The biologicallyderivedproduct-intendedRecipient extension can be used to record the intended recipient of the BiologicallyDerivedProduct to satisfy product traceability requirements, and does not represent administration, nor does it prevent administration to a different recipient at a future date. Further detail on the traceability requirements can be found in the BiologicallyDerivedProduct resource [Intended Recipients](http://hl7.org/fhir/biologicallyderivedproduct.html#intendedrecipient).

element.short: The intended recipient of a directed or designated biologically derived product
element.definition: The biologicallyderivedproduct-intendedRecipient extension can be used to record the intended recipient of the BiologicallyDerivedProduct to satisfy product traceability requirements, and does not represent administration, nor does it prevent administration to a different recipient at a future date. Further detail on the traceability requirements can be found in the BiologicallyDerivedProduct resource [Intended Recipients](http://hl7.org/fhir/biologicallyderivedproduct.html#intendedrecipient).
element.comment: The biologicallyderivedproduct-intendedRecipient extension and BiologicallyDerivedProduct.collection.sourcePatient can contain references to identifiable patients. Implementers shall ensure the appropriate data access controls are established.
